newsitem.title: USA: ViroGroup Inc names DeWayne Baskette CFO.
newsitem.headline: ViroGroup Inc names DeWayne Baskette CFO.

text.p: ViroGroup Inc said Monday that DeWayne Baskette has been named chief financial officer and vice president of finance and administration.

Baskette succeeds Larry Ackerly, who left the company after its decision to move its headquarters from Cape Coral, Florida, to Nashville, Tennessee, said Todd Vehring, vice president of sales and marketing for ViroGroup.
ViroGroup is an environmental engineering consulting company that also provides environmental information management services for manufacturing and other industries.
On January 22, the company did a one-for-eight reverse split of its common stock.
